_comment: Derived from the Government of India Local Government Directory (LGD) state directory export, 790 districts across 36 states and union territories. District names and codes are verbatim from that export; local-language names are kept as aliases. State names, ISO 3166-2 codes and STATE/UNION_TERRITORY types come from india-curated.json because LGD labels every row '(State)'. Regenerate with scripts/lgd_districts_to_json.py.
